name: Starter pack
description: Generic mood presets, a two-sound board and the pack guide. Works with any guitar and any effects; make your own pack to describe your gear.

scenes.name: Rainy Café
scenes.subtitle: Lo-fi chords for a slow afternoon
scenes.pickup: Neck pickup, tone rolled back a little

effects.name: Chorus or vibrato
details: Just enough wobble to sound like old tape

effects.name: Delay
effects.setting: Short slapback, one or two repeats

techniques: Seventh and ninth chords played softly
Lazy swing, a little behind the beat
Thumb on the bass notes, fingers on top
layers: Loop a two-chord vamp: Dm9 to G13
Add a muted, percussive strum on the off-beats
Noodle a Dorian melody over the top

scenes.name: Campfire
scenes.subtitle: Open chords for singing along
techniques: Boom-chuck strumming: bass note, then strum
Capo up to suit the singer
layers: Loop G, C, D in a steady strum
Play the major pentatonic melody over it
Try a walking bass line between chords

scenes.name: Haunted Hallway
scenes.subtitle: Spooky textures for game night

effects.name: Delay
details: Tape-style delay with some warble works best

techniques: Volume swells: pick with the volume down, then roll it up
layers: Loop a low E drone with a volume swell

scenes.name: Sunset Drive
scenes.subtitle: Big, open, cinematic
scenes.pickup: Bridge and neck together, or the middle position

effects.name: Delay
effects.setting: Dotted eighth, three or four repeats

techniques: Ringing open strings against fretted notes
Lydian's raised fourth for that floating feel
layers: Loop A to E in whole notes
Solo with slow bends on top
